result: All 23 tests pass. I created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` (JUnit 4, matching the project's existing tests) covering `CSVParser`: null-argument validation on the constructor and all three `parse` factory methods, basic record parsing, empty input, record/line number tracking, header map handling (explicit header, auto-detected from first line, skip-header-record, no header, and defensive copying), iterator behavior (`hasNext`/`next` idempotency, exhaustion, unsupported `remove`), `close`/`isClosed` semantics including idempotent close, null-string substitution, comment attachment, an unterminated-quote parse error, and resuming `getRecords()` mid-stream.
